notes.title: Demo Update 0.6
notes.content: [p]After a couple of months of work the update for the Demo is ready.[/p][p]The original Demo lacked in a lot of aspects but it was successful at starting to bring in feedback.[/p][p]This update addressees that feedback and expands on the game's features.[/p][p]The card fight in the original version lacked and couldn't really be called a card fight. The complete system and UI of it has been reworked and now should create some more interesting experiences i hope.[/p][p]There's been a lot of polishes in the way the ship controller works, making it easier to control the fleet, with some visual improvements to it.[/p][p]A few new ships have been added to slowly start assembling a "bit of everything". At the moment the game contains a small variability is ships from missile carriers to huge fuel carrying tankers to small agile fighter ships. To provide a challenge to the player and to also give them options on the battle field.[/p][p]Along with a lot more small changes that hopefully elevates the experience.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest from version 0.6 released
notes.content: [p]The past couple for months after releasing the original demo for Metal Coffin I've managed to gather a lot of feedback and got to see a lot of the shortcomings of the game.[/p][p]The 0.6 update aims to fix a lot of those and give the game some identity.[/p][p]To anyone who gets to try it I'd love to hear your thoughts.[/p][p]Full release of the demo build is expected in upcoming weeks.[/p]

notes.title: Metal Coffin official Discord server
notes.content:
While trying to keep the history of the updates in one place i thought it would be a nice idea to finally set up a proper discord server.
I was blessed enough to also find a couple of people who wished to help with the development and do some sporadic tests on updates i created, that was another reason a central hub was needed.
With all this in mind it made sense to put the word out of the server's existence.

To anyone interested i'd love to have you there.

Discord Invite : https://discord.gg/srMt8dGRWW
